## Editorial integrity

- [ ] No argument, unique claim, joke, example, step, or owner-locked wording was silently softened, removed, or replaced.
- [ ] Every proposed cut is explicit and satisfies the article's lossless-editing requirements.
- [ ] Empirical claims are supported, qualified, or clearly marked unresolved without flattening the author's position.
- [ ] Detector results are attached to exact passage evidence and did not override meaning or create a universal phrase rule.
- [ ] Current master, rejected cuts, unincorporated ideas, owner decisions, and source provenance were updated where applicable.
- [ ] Final diff contains no unrelated changes, private source material outside approved locations, credentials, or accidental publication artifacts.
